title: Embedded Banking Partnerships Are Going Bank-Direct – And So Is Treasury Prime
summary: Treasury Prime launches a new bank-direct product to enable the future of embedded banking partnerships.
body_text: For years, we’ve been saying that the future of banking is embedded, with regulated institutions and technology firms working closely together to deliver critical financial services within new channels and apps. However, it’s become increasingly clear to me that the future of embedded banking is through bank-direct, fintech partnerships. The market is settling on this model, and it’s happening fast. As a result, we are launching a new Bank-Direct product, which will empower banks to support the entire lifecycle of a direct relationship with a fintech customer, including the sales, onboarding, management, and support of that partnership. This is leading to some significant changes to ensure our company is best positioned to help our customers succeed. The evolution of our industry is already underway. Consider that almost every leading fintech business – Affirm, Chime, Square, and Wealthfront, to name a few – now works directly with a bank or has bought one. In just the last few months, many banks are quietly ramping up their in-house fintech business development capabilities, and a growing number of our clients are telling us that they want to close their own fintech deals. At the same time, banking regulators are carefully scrutinizing fintech partner banks, shutting down fintech partnerships, and issuing consent decrees. Reading between the lines – or sometimes the lines themselves – regulators want banking institutions, not intermediaries, to have direct oversight of their fintech partners. If Treasury Prime is to be at the forefront of embedded banking, our business strategy must evolve with our clients’ needs. Going forward, our new Bank-Direct product will sharpen our focus on bank-direct, fintech relationships, while we continue to support all of the banks, fintechs, and service providers that rely on our network. What does that mean? ‍ First , Treasury Prime’s industry-leading, Bank-Direct product will make real-time collaboration between bank and fintech partners simple and convenient. With new self-service tooling and features, banks can more easily access actionable insights, customize risk controls, and utilize our unified dashboard that fosters joint collaboration with their fintech partners. ‍ Second , Treasury Prime will be reorienting our sales strategy to support banks as they close their own fintech deals and make it easier for them to onboard these customers. We will arm banks with sales collateral and coach them through their negotiations instead of playing the matchmaking role we had in the past. For example, we are creating a new business development group that will provide specialized expertise to banks seeking out large fintech customers to assist in winning those deals. We also plan to roll-out new enablement tools, including targeted investments in compliance automation that make it easier to identify the fintechs they want to sign up. What’s more, we have already begun streamlining the contractual relationship so that it is clear to regulators that the bank has direct oversight of their fintech customer. And more improvements are on the way. ‍ Third , we will continue to support our existing fintech partners who use our platform today. There should be no impact on their business. Literally none. In fact, we are putting additional, dedicated resources in place so that we can respond to fintech clients more quickly. While I firmly believe these measures will position Treasury Prime to lead the way in modernizing banking, they have also forced us to make some difficult decisions. As we sharpen our focus to support banks as they target the largest and most innovative fintechs with the Bank-Direct product, we need to rethink the way we are organized. As a result, some very talented colleagues will be leaving our firm or redeployed to other parts of our company. Still, I remain confident and enthusiastic about the long-term opportunity ahead. The steps we are taking now will enable us to serve our customers more effectively, strengthen the oversight and compliance that regulators demand, and ultimately lay the foundation for a safer and more sustainable, embedded banking ecosystem.

title: A Product I Never Expected to Discuss Again
summary: A new market trend has emerged this year. Financial products that had seemingly been left for dead have returned to life. Binary options, which were launched in 2008, never really took off in their exchange-traded formats but later morphed into the basic logic behind prediction markets (such as IBKR ForecastTrader). Today, the CME returns single stock futures (SSF) to the market landscape. Hey, at least this means we can once again refer to quarterly expirations as “quadruple witching.”

title: IDEXX Releases 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report, Highlighting Progress Against Its Goals
summary: WESTBROOK, Maine--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- IDEXX Laboratories, Inc. (Nasdaq: IDXX), a global leader in pet healthcare innovation, today released its…...
body_text: IDEXX Releases 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report, Highlighting Progress Against Its Goals July 28, 2026 7:00am EDT WESTBROOK, Maine--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- IDEXX Laboratories, Inc. (Nasdaq: IDXX), a global leader in pet healthcare innovation, today released its 2025 Corporate Responsibility Report , highlighting progress against the company’s goals and commitments. This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260728755319/en/ 2025 IDEXX Corporate Responsibility Report “At IDEXX, corporate responsibility is central to how we create long-term value,” said Mike Erickson, IDEXX President and Chief Executive Officer. “The progress reflected in this report is the result of sustained investments in innovation, our people, and capabilities that support our customers every day. These priorities are deeply connected to our business strategy and purpose, strengthening our company today while positioning us for future innovation and growth.” The Care We Advance Veterinary medicine is undergoing rapid transformation as advances in science and technology enable earlier detection, faster diagnosis, and deeper insights into disease. IDEXX is helping lead that evolution through innovations that bring screening and diagnosis closer together and expand access to advanced diagnostics. Over the past year, IDEXX: Significantly advanced its innovation portfolio by launching or achieving launch readiness for multiple solutions , led by the IDEXX Cancer Dx™ Panel with canine lymphoma detection and new fine needle aspirate (FNA) cytology capabilities for mast cell tumors on the IDEXX inVue Dx™ Cellular Analyzer, helping address one of veterinary medicine’s greatest unmet needs. Raised the standard for diagnostic imaging with the ImageVue™ DR50 Plus Digital Imaging System, combining advanced AI and the industry’s lowest radiation dose to help protect veterinary teams. Helped enable access to care for more than 45,000 animals in underserved communities in 2025, bringing the cumulative number supported through global social initiatives since 2022 to more than 749,000 animals. The People We Support Innovation begins with people. IDEXX continues to invest in the capabilities, development, and engagement of its workforce, recognizing that strong teams are essential to advancing science, serving customers, and supporting long-term growth. Notable highlights include: Received recognition as a top disability-inclusive business from the Disability Index. Logged 121,400 hours of learning and development, including 46,700 hours of STEM and AI learning . Surpassed its employee volunteering goal with more than 24,000 logged volunteer hours , exceeding its annual goal of 15,000 hours. The Planet We Share As a global company, IDEXX remains focused on managing resources responsibly and reducing its environmental footprint. The company remains on track to meet its 2030 GHG emissions reduction goal and anticipates significant emissions reductions in the next few years. Progress in 2025 reflected continued investment in renewable electricity, operational efficiency, and initiatives designed to reduce waste and extend product life. Across its operations, IDEXX: Signed its first virtual power purchase agreement (VPPA) in Europe , bringing the total to three VPPAs expected to source enough renewable electricity to cover 100% of IDEXX’s North American and European electricity consumption when they come online. Continued the transition of its commercial fleet to hybrid and electric vehicle models, which represented approximately 42% of its fleet at year-end 2025. Extended instrument life and improved reliability for customers by servicing more than 35,000 instruments and completing 85,000 point-of-service upgrades on select IDEXX instruments . This Corporate Responsibility Report covers topics the company believes are relevant to our business and stakeholders. IDEXX uses well-established reporting standards generally aligned with frameworks, such as those released by the Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB) and the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD). Read the report here . About IDEXX IDEXX is a global leader in pet healthcare innovation. Our diagnostic and software products and services create clarity in the complex evolving world of veterinary medicine. We support longer, fuller lives for pets by delivering insights and solutions that help the veterinary community around the world make confident decisions—to advance medical care, improve efficiency, and build thriving practices. Our innovations also help measure the safety of milk and water across the world and maintain the health and well-being of people and livestock. IDEXX Laboratories, Inc. is a member of the S&P 500™ Index. Headquartered in Maine, IDEXX employs approximately 11,000 people and offers solutions and products to customers in more than 175 countries and territories. For more information about IDEXX, visit: www.idexx.com . title: Jurusan Manajemen Adalah: Informasi Terlengkapnya!
summary: Masih ragu untuk kuliah jurusan manajemen? Di jurusan ini, kamu tidak hanya belajar tentang pengelolaan perusahaan saja lho. Pelajari hal-hal lainnya disini!
body_text: Daftar isi Kuliah jurusan manajemen hingga kini masih menajdi salah satu jurusan terfavorit dalam rumpun ilmu pengetahuan sosial. Baik itu anak sekolah menengah lulusan jurusan IPS maupun IPA, banyak yang mengincar untuk bisa berkuliah jurusan manajemen. Maka dari itu, untuk bisa berkuliah di jurusan ini, persaingannya tergolong cukup ketat. Hampir semua perguruan tinggi di Indonesia memiliki jurusan manajemen. Ada yang tergabung dalam Fakultas Ekonomi, ada pula yang masuk dalam Sekolah Bisnis. Beberapa sekolah tinggi dan akademi bahkan fokus dalam jurusan manajemen saja. Manajemen adalah ilmu yang luas dan dibutuhkan dalam semua aspek kehidupan, terutama dalam penyelenggaraan perusahaan dan organisasi. Oleh karena itu, jurusan ini banyak menerima mahasiswa karena prospek lapangan kerja yang terbuka lebar dan selalu dibutuhkan. Jika kamu tertarik untuk mengambil jurusan ini di perguruan tinggi simak pembahasan berikut mengenai informasi lengkap kuliah jurusan manajemen. Apa Itu Kuliah Jurusan Manajemen Jika membahas kuliah jurusan manajemen, maka hal mendasar yang harus dipahami terlebih dahulu adalah jurusan manajemen itu sendiri. Jurusan manajemen adalah ilmu yang mempelajari cara merencanakan, mengatur, dan mengelola perusahaan atau organisasi untuk mencapai tujuan yang diinginkan. Lebih lanjut, kuliah jurusan manajemen adalah ilmu yang mempelajari berbagai kegiatan dari suatu perusahaan untuk mengelola, merencanakan sampai mengembangkan suatu strategi serta organisasi hingga bisa mencapai suatu tujuan. Maka dari itu, jurusan manajemen masih berkaitan erat dengan bidang ilmu lain seperti ekonomi dan bisnis. Karena hal ini, banyak universitas di Indonesia yang mengelompokkan jurusan manajemen ke dalam Fakultas Ekonomi dan Bisnis. Selama berkuliah jurusan manajemen, mahasiswa akan dituntut untuk memahami cara penggunaan sumber daya secara efektif untuk mencapai target sasaran. Ilmu yang didapat dan dipelajari selama kuliah jurusan manajemen juga bisa digunakan atau dipraktikkan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari. Pembelajaran di Kuliah Jurusan Manajemen Pada umumnya, di jurusan manajemen nantinya kamu akan mempelajari segala hal yang berkaitan tentang ekonomi, bisnis dan perusahaan, seperti halnya mengatur SDM yang ada. Pada semester-semester awal, kamu akan mempelajari materi yang sifatnya umum terlebih dahulu yang bertujuan sebagai pengenalan. Lalu, memasuki semester pertengahan, kamu baru akan mulai mempelajari materi yang sifatnya lebih spesifik atau peminatan. Menjadi mahasiswa yang berkuliah jurusan manajemen, nantinya kamu akan belajar bagaimana menyusun suatu planning, memecahkan suatu masalah yang muncul dalam sistem operasional, merencanakan suatu bisnis, dan mengumpulkan hingga mengolah data dari penelitian. Tak hanya belajar teorinya saja, mahasiswa jurusan manajemen juga akan dihadapkan dengan praktik langsung untuk menerapkan apa yang telah dipahami di bawah bimbingan dosen. Mata kuliah jurusan manajemen diantaranya adalah ekonomi manajerial, komunikasi bisnis, manajemen strategi, manajemen risiko, kepemimpinan, rencana bisnis, hingga perilaku konsumen. Baca juga: Informasi terbaru Penerimaan Mahasiswa Baru Universitas Bina Sarana Informatika 2022 Peminatan atau Konsentrasi Kuliah Jurusan Manajemen Hal yang tak kalah penting perlu diketahui yaitu jurusan manajemen terbagi ke dalam beberapa peminatan atau konsentrasi. Seperti yang sudah dipaparkan sebelumnya, mulai dari semester pertengahan, akan ada peminatan atau konsentrasi. Setiap perguruan tinggi memiliki kebijakannya masing-masing dalam menentukan peminatan, ada yang dimulai dari awal perkuliahan, semester 4, semester 6, atau saat penulisan tugas akhir. Peminatan ini bertujuan agar mahasiswa dapat lebih fokus mendalami ilmu manajemen yang diminati. Secara umum, terdapat beberapa peminatan di jurusan manajemen, yaitu: Manajemen sumber daya manusia. Konsentrasi ini fokus untuk memahami perencanaan dan pengelolaan sumber daya manusia dalam menjalankan perusahaan atau organisasi. Ilmu manajemen ini diperkuat dengan teknik analisis dan psikologis agar sumber daya manusia dapat produktif untuk mencapai tujuan. Manajemen operasi. Ilmu ini mempelajari sistem operasional atau produksi di dalam perusahaan secara efektif. Manajemen pemasaran. Peminatan ini fokus mendalami ilmu strategi dan analisis untuk memasarkan produk dalam persaingan bisnis yang ketat. Manajemen keuangan. Ilmu ini bakal mempelajari cara mengatur dan mengelola keuangan dengan baik dalam perusahaan. Manajemen bisnis. Konsentrasi ini bakal mendalami strategi dan analisis bisnis. Pengelolaan bisnis mulai dari awal berdiri hingga menjaga kesinambungan perusahaan bakal dipelajari di konsentrasi ini. Manajemen perbankan. Ilmu ini mempelajari manajerial khusus pada dunia perbankan mulai dari pengumpulan dana, hingga penyaluran kredit. Ada beberapa hal yang dibutuhkan dan salah satu kemampuan mendasar yang harus dimiliki yaitu kemampuan mengatur uang. Selanjutnya, kamu juga harus memiliki kemampuan kepemimpinan atau leadership yang baik karena seperti yang sudah dibahas sebelumnya, kamu akan mengatur SDM dalam suatu organisasi. Hal ini kemudian juga menuntut kamu untuk memiliki kemampuan bersosialisasi dan komunikasi yang baik. Yang tak kalah penting dan tidak boleh dilupakan yaitu kamu juga harus memiliki kemampuan analisis yang baik. Dengan begitu, kamu bisa dengan mudah memecahkan permasalahan yang muncul. Tidak ada perusahaan yang tidak memiliki manajemen di dalamnya. Tentunya lulusan jurusan manajemen akan memiliki peluang kerja yang terbuka lebar. Selain itu, karena jurusan manajemen juga berhubungan dengan ilmu-ilmu lainnya, kesempatan untuk kamu belajar berbagai bidang sekaligus juga semakin besar. Kamu tidak akan hanya belajar satu ilmu saja, sehingga pembelajarannya akan jauh lebih menarik. Prospek Kerja Bagi mahasiswa lulusan jurusan manajemen, pada umumnya memiliki prospek kerja di bidang ekonomi atau bisnis. Selain itu, pada dasarnya lulusan ini juga diharapkan untuk dapat menjadi manajer atau pimpinan yang bertanggung jawab atas jalannya perusahaan dan organisasi. Lulusan jurusan manajemen pun harus bisa membagi tugas dan tanggung jawab setiap anggotanya. Lebih lanjut, lulusan jurusan manajemen dapat bekerja di seluruh perusahaan seperti swasta, pemerintah, maupun yayasan atau organisasi non-profit. Semua bidang industri seperti perbankan, retail, perminyakan dan sebagainya membutuhkan lulusan manajemen. Lulusan jurusan manajemen dapat bekerja menjadi analis bisnis, HRD, recruiter, penasihat keuangan, analis investasi, dan konsultan bisnis, sales , analis kredit atau perbankan, maupun product manager. Selain bekerja pada perusahaan, lulusan jurusan manajemen bisnis yang memiliki jiwa entrepreneur juga bisa membuka usaha sendiri dan menciptakan lapangan kerja untuk banyak orang.
